name: Hoburne Park
beachAccess: A few minutes' walk from Avon Beach
confirmedFeatures: Indoor and outdoor pools, sauna, fitness room, tennis, adventure golf, restaurant, bar, launderette
overview: A holiday park on Hoburne Lane in Christchurch, a few minutes' walk from Avon Beach and a short drive west of Highcliffe. It has caravans and lodges with indoor and outdoor pools and a restaurant.
surfTripFit: Puts you between Avon Beach and Highcliffe, so you can choose a spot to suit the conditions.
